title: Multi-Agents are Social Groups: Investigating Social Influence of Multiple Agents in Human-Agent Interactions
reasoning: The paper focuses on the psychological mechanisms of social influence (normative and informational) exerted by multi-agent systems on humans during discussions of social topics. It does not evaluate or benchmark religious beliefs, moral frameworks, or ethical reasoning capabilities of the models themselves; it utilizes social issues like self-driving cars and video game violence merely as experimental stimuli.
